SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.    File No............
S.1, Special Branch.
REPORT
Date May 2, 19 38.

Subject Printing Shop of the Refugee Relief Committee of the 1st
Special District Citizens' Federation.

Made by D.S. Henchman    Forwarded by C Crawford. D.S.

With reference to the Printing Shop of the Refugee
Relief Committee of the 1st Special District Citizens'
Federation, Lane 39, No.3, Amoy Road, mentioned in the
attached report, I have to state that this shop began to
operate on March 22, 1938, with a complement of some 50
hands who were selected from refugees accommodated in the
various camps under the control of the Refugee Relief Com-
mittee mentioned above. In operating the printing shop,
the committee, which is in charge of Mr. Liu Zoong Ying
(刘仲英), a prominent member of the 1st Special District
Citizens' Federation, aims at providing work for refugees.

The shop was formerly known as the Vee Ih Printing
Press which, owing to trade depression, ceased operations
recently and later was taken over by the 1st Special District
Citizens' Federation. Wang Wo Soong (汪和松), owner of the
defunct Vee Ih Printing Press, is the present manager.

Towards the end of April of this year, a rumour was
in circulation to the effect that the establishment in
question was printing propaganda matter of a national
salvation nature, this, however, could not be confirmed.

Copy to Sen. Det.
Longa.

关于附件报告中提及的第一特区市民联合会难民救济委员会印刷所（厦门路3号39弄），本人谨陈述如下：该印刷所于1938年3月22日开始运营，拥有约50名员工，这些员工是从上述难民救济委员会管辖的各个难民营中挑选出来的难民。在运营该印刷所时，由第一特区市民联合会知名成员刘仲英 (Liu Zoong Ying) 负责的委员会，旨在为难民提供工作机会。

该店前身为 Vee Ih 印刷厂，因商业萧条近期停止运营，后被第一特区市民联合会接管。已倒闭的 Vee Ih 印刷厂业主 Wang Wo Soong (汪和松) 是现任经理。

今年四月下旬，有谣言流传称该机构正在印制具有救国性质的宣传品，但这未能得到证实。

Reference, alleged distribution of pamphlets of an anti-Japanese
nature.

S.M.C. Police Station

Sir,

At 7 p.m. on the 30-4-38 . . . S3 senior constable on duty in
the vicinity of Amoy and Yu Ya Ching Roads observed a male
Chinese (name unknown) (illegible), No. 14, residing
House 2, Lane 33, Amoy Road, in possession of a bundle of pamphlets
which when translated were as follows:-

1. . . . comrades . . . we should
solidify our . . . and make more efforts in
carrying out the . . . of . . .
2. In commemorating the May 1st Labour Day, the capital
and labour class should co-operate in increasing the
production so that the national strength will be
increased.
3. Labourer comrades should mobilize to support the
Government and assist the troops in waging the war of
resistance.
4. Not to be deceived by the traitors; swear not to
recognize the "bogus" organizations.
5. Support the Kuomintang Party and General Chiang, our
leader.
6. Long live the May 1st Labour Day!
7. Long live the Chinese Republic!

The 800,000 Labourers
of the Shanghai Municipa-
lity.

and was seen to distribute same to passers-by.

P.S. Rader effected his arrest and brought him to this
Station, where, the suspect when questioned stated that he was
employed by the Shanghai Refugee Relief Committee of the First
Special District Citizens' Federation, premises Lane 33, No.3
Amoy Road as an assistant. At about 6.45 p.m. on the 30-4-38
he had been given the pamphlets (312) by one named Tong Ching
Soong (唐正生), who is also employed by the aforementioned
Federation and resident there.

C.D.C. 42, Clerk Liao, Det. Henchman and D.S. Brotherton
visited the aforementioned address and conducted a search of
the premises, where, nine printing machines and 54 apprentices,

敬启者：

1938年4月30日晚7时……第53号高级巡长（原文不清）在厦门路与虞洽卿路附近执勤时，观察到一名男性华人（姓名不详）（原文不清），住厦门路33弄2号14室，持有一捆传单，翻译内容如下：-

1. ……同志们……我们应该巩固我们的……并在执行……的……方面更加努力。
2. 在纪念五一劳动节之际，资本家和工人阶级应合作增加生产，以增强国力。
3. 工友同志们应动员起来支持政府，协助军队进行抗战。
4. 不受汉奸欺骗；发誓不承认“伪”组织。
5. 支持国民党及我们的领袖蒋介石将军。
6. 五一劳动节万岁！
7. 中华民国万岁！

上海市八十万劳工。

并被看到向路人分发这些传单。

附言：巡警 Rader 将其逮捕并带至本捕房，经讯问，嫌疑人称其受雇于第一特区市民联合会上海难民救济委员会，地址为厦门路3号33弄，职务为助理。1938年4月30日下午6时45分左右，他从一个名叫 Tong Ching Soong (唐正生) 的人那里收到了传单（312份），此人也受雇于上述联合会并居住在那里。

第42号刑事侦缉队长、书记员廖、探员 Henchman 和警佐 Brotherton 前往上述地址并对该场所进行了搜查，在那里，九台印刷机和54名学徒，

operate under the name of the Printing Shop of the Refugee
Relief Committee of the Shanghai 1st Special District Citizens'
Federation. The manager Wong Ching Fung (王清風) was located

as foreman type-setter, working at the aforementioned address

Wong Ching Fung was not present when the police visited,

A search of the premises failed to find any additional

Mr. Robertson, D.C.I. was communicated with and the facts

以上海第一特区市民联合会难民救济委员会印刷所的名义运营。找到了经理 Wong Ching Fung (王清風)，并从他那里得知，Wong Ching Fung 受雇为领班排字工，在所述地址工作，是由现任经理推荐的。他表示，传单并非在上述地址印刷，也不知道 Wong Ching Fung 已将传单交给他的嫌疑人。

警方访问时 Wong Ching Fung 不在场，他在晚7点后不久（1938年4月30日）外出，不过，已派一名探员在所述地址蹲守，等待 Wong Ching Fung 返回。

对该场所的搜查未发现任何其他类似性质的文献。已获取 Lee Poh Yuen 和 Wong Soo Foong 的供词并附后。

已与刑事侦缉督察 Robertson 先生取得联系，并向他概述了上述事实，根据他的指示，两名嫌疑人在 Wong Ching Fung 被捕前予以留置。

调查正在进行中。

J. Smith

Zee Foh Yuen (徐福元)
Shanghai                                      D.S. Henshman
Louza Station           30/4/38                Clerk Xiao.

My name is Zee Foh Yuen. I am 18 years of age, a native
of Shanghai, residing in the Printing Shop of the Refugee
Relief Committee of the Shanghai 1st Special District Citizens'
Federation, Lane 39, S. Amoy Road, at which shop I am employed
as an apprentice.

At about 6.45 p.m. April 30, 1938, Wong Ching Sung
(王金生), foreman of the Typesetting Department of the
above mentioned printing shop, gave me about 60 copies of
a pamphlet bearing on the May 1st International Labour Day
Anniversary and instructed me to distribute them in the street.

At about 7 p.m. while I was distributing these pamphlets
at the corner of Peking and Yu Ya Ching Roads, I was arrested
by a foreign policeman and taken to Louza Station.

I don't know where Wong obtained these pamphlets,
which, I am definitely sure, were not printed in the shop
at which we are employed. Apart from those which Wong gave
me, I saw no other pamphlets of a similar nature. As far as
I know I am the only person to whom Wong gave pamphlets for
distribution.

I had never before distributed any pamphlets or handbills.
I am not a member of any political party nor am I interested
in politics.

A description of Wong Ching Sung is as follows:-
Age: about 35, Height: 5'5", Slim build, Yellow complexion,
wearing a black long gown and a woollen cap.

(Signed) Zee Foh Yuen.
pages.zh:
Zee Foh Yuen (徐福元)
上海                                      警佐 Henshman
老闸捕房           1938年4月30日                书记员 Xiao。

我叫 Zee Foh Yuen。我今年18岁，上海人，居住在厦门南路39弄上海第一特区市民联合会难民救济委员会印刷所，我在该印刷所担任学徒。

1938年4月30日下午6时45分左右，上述印刷所排版部领班 Wong Ching Sung (王金生) 给了我大约60份关于五一国际劳动节纪念日的传单，并指示我在街上分发。

下午7点左右，当我在北京路和虞洽卿路路口分发这些传单时，我被一名外籍警察逮捕并带到老闸捕房。

我不知道 Wong 从哪里得到这些传单，我可以肯定，这些传单不是在我们受雇的印刷所印制的。除了 Wong 给我的那些，我没有看到其他类似性质的传单。据我所知，我是 Wong 唯一给予传单进行分发的人。

我以前从未分发过任何传单或小册子。我不是任何政党的成员，也对政治不感兴趣。

Wong Ching Sung 的外貌描述如下：
年龄：约35岁，身高：5英尺5英寸，身材瘦削，面色黄，身穿黑色长袍，头戴羊毛帽。

（签名）Zee Foh Yuen。

pages.en:
Wong Wo Soong (王和松)
Shaoching                                Des. Hanchman
Louza Station        20/1/39             Clerk also.

My name is Wong Wo Soong. I am 35 years of age, a native
of Shaoching, employed as the supervisor of the Printing Shop
of the Refugee Relief Committee of the 1st Special District
Citizens' Federation, situated at Lane 39, 3, Amoy Road, where
I am residing.

Zee Fot Yuen is an apprentice in my printing shop, and
has been working in that capacity for the past one and half
months. I don't know from where he had obtained the pamphlets
which were seized by the Police in his possession. It is
definite that they were not printed in my shop.

Wong Ching Sung is the foreman of the typesetting
department of my shop. He was appointed to this job about
one and half months ago. He resides in the shop.

Both Zee and Wong obtained their employment at my shop
through the recommendation of the Refugee Relief Committee
of the 1st Special District Citizens' Federation. As far
as I know, they were formerly accommodated in certain refugee
camps under the control of the committee as refugees.

(Signed) Wong Wo Soong.
pages.zh:
Wong Wo Soong (王和松)
绍兴                                探员 Hanchman
老闸捕房        1939年1月20日             书记员 also。

我叫 Wong Wo Soong。我今年35岁，绍兴人，受雇为第一特区市民联合会难民救济委员会印刷所的主管，该印刷所位于厦门路3号39弄，我就住在那里。

Zee Fot Yuen 是我印刷所的学徒，已在此职位工作了一个半月。我不知道他从哪里获得了被警察查获的那些传单。可以肯定的是，它们不是在我的店里印制的。

Wong Ching Sung 是我店里排版部的领班。他大约在一年半前被任命担任此职。他住在店里。

Zee 和 Wong 都是通过第一特区市民联合会难民救济委员会的推荐在我店里找到工作的。据我所知，他们以前作为难民安置在该委员会控制的某些难民营中。

（签名）Wong Wo Soong。

巡警 Bader 将其逮捕并带至本捕房，经讯问，嫌疑人称其受雇于第一特区市民联合会上海难民救济委员会，地址为厦门路3号33弄，职务为助理。1938年4月30日下午6时45分左右，他从一个名叫 Wong Ching Soong (王全生) 的人那里收到了传单（212份），此人也受雇于上述联合会并居住在那里。

第42号刑事侦缉队长、书记员廖、警佐 Henchman 和警佐 Bretherton 前往上述地址并对该场所进行了搜查，在那里，九台印刷机和54名学徒，

以“上海第一特区市民联合会难民救济委员会印刷所”的名义运作。经理王和松（Wong Wo Soong）已被找到，据其称，王金生（Wong Ching Sung）受雇为排字领班，居住于上述地址，系由该联合会推荐。他确信上述小册子并非在上述地址印刷，也不知道这些小册子是王金生交给嫌疑人的。
警方走访时王金生不在场，他于晚上7点后不久（1938年4月30日）外出，不过，已派一名侦探在上述地址蹲守监视，等待王金生返回。
对场所的搜查未发现任何其他类似性质的宣传品。已录取徐福元（Tee Foh Yuen）和王和松的供词，附于本件之后。
已与“A”区副督察长罗伯逊先生（Mr. Robertson, D.O. "A"）取得联系，并向其概述了上述事实，根据其指示，两名嫌疑人已被拘留，待王金生被捕后再作处理。
调查正在进行中。
（签名：R. Smith）

pages.en:
Zee Foh Yuen (徐福元)
Shanghai                                Det. Watchman
Louza Station        30/4/38             Clerk Liao.

My name is Zee Foh Yuen. I am 18 years of age, a native
of Shanghai, residing in the Printing Shop of the Refugee
Relief Committee of the Shanghai 1st Special District Citizens'
Federation, Lane 39, 3, Amoy Road, at which shop I am employed
as an apprentice.
    At about 6.45 p.m. April 30, 1938, Wong Ching Sung
(王金生), foreman of the Typesetting Department of the
above mentioned printing shop, gave me about 80 copies of
a pamphlet bearing on the May 1st International Labour Day
Anniversary and instructed me to distribute them in the street.
    At about 7 p.m. while I was distributing these pamphlets
at the corner of Peking and Yu Ya Ching Roads, I was arrested
by a foreign policeman and taken to Louza Station.
    I don't know where Wong had obtained these pamphlets,
which, I can definitely say, were not printed in the shop
at which we are employed. Apart from those which Wong gave
me, I saw no other pamphlets of a similar nature. As far as
I know I am the only person to whom Wong gave pamphlets for
distribution.
    I had never before distributed any pamphlets or handbills.
I am not a member of any political party nor am I interested
in politics.
    A description of Wong Ching Sung is as follows:-
Age: about 35, Height: 5'5", Slim build, Yellow complexion,
wearing a black long gown and a woollen cap.
                        (Signed) Zee Foh Yuen.
pages.zh:
徐福元（Zee Foh Yuen）
上海                                巡捕房守望员
老闸捕房        1938年4月30日             书记员廖氏。

我叫徐福元。我今年18岁，上海人，居住在厦门路3弄39号上海第一特区市民联合会难民救济委员会印刷所，我在该所当学徒。
    1938年4月30日下午6点45分左右，上述印刷所排字部领班王金生（Wong Ching Sung）给了我大约80份关于五一国际劳动节纪念的小册子，并指示我在街上分发。
    晚上7点左右，当我在北京路与虞洽卿路（Yu Ya Ching Roads）拐角处分发这些小册子时，被一名外籍巡捕逮捕，并带至老闸捕房。
    我不知道王金生是从哪里得到这些小册子的，我可以肯定地说，它们不是在我们受雇的印刷所印刷的。除了王金生给我的那些之外，我没有看到其他类似性质的小册子。据我所知，我是王金生唯一给予小册子进行分发的人。
    我以前从未分发过任何小册子或传单。我不是任何政党的成员，也对政治不感兴趣。
    王金生的体貌特征如下：
年龄：约35岁，身高：5英尺5英寸，身材瘦削，面色黄，身穿黑色长袍，头戴羊毛帽。
                        （签名）徐福元。

pages.en:
Wong Wo Soong (王和松)
Shaoshing                                U.S. Henchman
Louza Station          30/4/38           Clerk Liao.

My name is Wong Wo Soong. I am 35 years of age, a native
of Shaoshing, employed as the supervisor of the Printing Shop
of the Refugee Relief Committee of the 1st Special District
Citizens' Federation, situated at Lane 39, 3, Amoy Road, where
I am residing.

Zee Poh Yuen is an apprentice in my printing shop, and
has been working in that capacity for the past one and half
months. I don't know from where he had obtained the pamphlet
which were seized by the Police in his possession. It is
definite that they were not printed in my shop.

Wong Ching Sung is the foreman of the typesetting
department of my shop. He was appointed to this job about
one and half months ago. He resides in the shop.

Both Zee and Wong obtained their employment at my shop
through the recommendation of the Refugee Relief Committee
of the 1st Special District Citizens' Federation. As far
as I know, they were formerly accommodated in certain refugee
camps under the control of the committee as refugees.

(Signed) Wong Wo Soong.
pages.zh:
王和松（Wong Wo Soong）
绍兴                                美籍华人助手
老闸捕房          1938年4月30日           书记员廖氏。

我叫王和松。我今年35岁，绍兴人，受雇为位于厦门路3弄39号的第一特区市民联合会难民救济委员会印刷所的监工，我就居住在该处。

徐福元（Zee Poh Yuen）是我印刷所的学徒，在此职位上工作已有一个半月。我不知道他从何处获得了被警方从他身上查获的小册子。可以肯定的是，它们不是在我的印刷所印刷的。

王金生是我印刷所排字部的领班。他大约在一年半前被任命担任此职。他居住在印刷所内。

徐和金两人都是通过第一特区市民联合会难民救济委员会的推荐在我店里获得工作的。据我所知，他们以前作为难民，被安置在该委员会控制的某些难民营中。

（签名）王和松。
